verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS equity-management platform like Vestd, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics, cookie or tracking controls, or any opt-out mechanism. The data-room access controls are a different feature and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
